title: Matikanetaunnhauser (Mambo) Character
description: Adds a friendly Matikanetaunnhouser (Mambo) that will follow you and defend you from hostile mobs!
body:
# What This Mod Does:
Adds a friendly Matikanetaunnhouser (Mambo) that will follow you around and defend you from hostile mobs!

Mambo is able to spawn naturally, having a 10% chance to spawn with each horse that spawns.
(At least thats how it is meant to work, sometimes she spawns on her own and idrk why)


## AI Disclosure:
This is my first mod I have made for minecraft, I utilised generative AI to learn about how functions work and assist in the debugging of some (but not all) parts of the mod.

This disclosure is here since I don't want to hide if I use AI for stuff, I am still learning and will utilise it less and less as I understand more of how the game works and how to create mods for it, please be patient with me :)
